description: This file defines functions for converting between internal QUIC error codes and string representations, as well as mapping error codes to HTTP/3 and IETF QUIC error codes, and handling error code conversions for QUIC streams.

classes.name: QuicResetStreamError
classes.description: Represents errors for QUIC stream resets, with static methods to create instances from internal or IETF error codes.

methods.name: QuicRstStreamErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicRstStreamErrorCode to its string literal.

methods.name: QuicErrorCodeToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicErrorCode to its string literal.

methods.name: QuicIetfTransportErrorCodeString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a QuicIetfTransportErrorCodes value.

methods.name: QuicErrorCodeToTransportErrorCode
methods.description: Maps a QuicErrorCode to its corresponding IETF transport error code.

methods.name: TlsAlertToQuicErrorCode
methods.description: Converts an SSL/TLS alert description to a QuicErrorCode.

methods.name: RstStreamErrorCodeToIetfResetStreamErrorCode
methods.description: Converts a QuicRstStreamErrorCode to an IETF QUIC reset stream error code.

methods.name: QuicResetStreamError::FromInternal
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from an internal QuicRstStreamErrorCode.

methods.name: QuicResetStreamError::FromIetf
methods.description: Creates a QuicResetStreamError from an IETF error code (uint64_t or enum).
